subject: How to get root-to-tip branch lengths of all tips in ggtree

messages.author: 0efbb40685f1fe34
messages.subject: How to get root-to-tip branch lengths of all tips in ggtree
parts: I want to get root-to-tip branch lengths of all tips, and generate a csv file, the first column is the tip, the second is corresponding root-to-tip branch length

messages.author: 2440aab9c066ba65
messages.subject: Re: How to get root-to-tip branch lengths of all tips in ggtree
parts:
When you make a tree with ggtree the root-to-tip branch length are in the x-coordinate.
Thus when you do:

tr <- rtree(10)
p <- ggtree(tr)

then in the data frame p$data the nodenumbers are in column 1 and the root-to-tip branch lengths in column 4

> set.seed(20170105)
> tr= rtree(10)
> df = fortify(tr)
> df[df$parent == getRoot(tr) & df$isTip, "branch.length"]
[1] 0.6976979
